 Coram : Neeraj P. Dhote, J.
 Dated : October 14, 2025
Per Court :-
.
Heard the learned Advocate for the Applicant and the learned APP for the State.
Perused the papers on record.

2. The case of the Prosecution, in brief, is that, on 30.07.2025 the Officers from the Narcotic Cell raided the Pan Shop situated near the bus stand at Jintur and found the banned Gutkha and Tobacco worth Rs.5580/-.

They seized the said Articles and lodged the Report with the Jintur Police Station and Crime bearing No.0430/2025 came to be registered for the offence punishable under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275,
3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (for short, 'BNS') and under Sections 59 (i), 59 (ii) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3.
As per the Prosecution, the Co-accused stated that, the said contraband was supplied by the Applicant.
Except Section 123 of the  2  BNS, all the sections are bailable.

sentences.text: ORDER i) In the event of arrest of the Applicant, namely, Sopan Suresh Dombe in connection with Crime bearing No.0430/2025 registered with Jintur Police Station, Dist. Parbhani, he be released on bail on executing P.B. of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand) with one or two surety/sureties in the like amount.
ii) The Applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station from 16.10.2025 to 18.10.2025 between 11:00 a.m. to 02:00 p.m. and thereafter as and when called.
iii) The Applicant shall not tamper the evidence of the Prosecution in any manner.
iv) The Applicant shall co-operate with the investigating machinery.
v) Issue notice to the Respondents, returnable after four (4) weeks.
The learned APP waives notice for the Respondents - State.
( NEERAJ P. DHOTE, J. ) GGP Signed by: Gajanan G. Punde Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 14/10/2025 18:46:41
